key_insight: PathKGen combines slide-image features with structured pathology knowledge to generate histopathology reports and expose part of its reasoning as graphs.
clinical_relevance: The approach could make automated pathology reports easier to inspect, but the abstract does not establish clinical safety or diagnostic benefit.
method: A visual branch uses pathology foundation models to create image tokens from whole-slide images.
A knowledge branch queries a pathology-specific knowledge graph to create tokens representing key morphological features.
An MLLM combines both inputs to generate reports with graph-based reasoning visualizations.
evidence_signal: Evaluation on WSI-Bench reportedly outperformed prior state-of-the-art methods, though the abstract provides no numerical results.
watch_item: Reasoning graphs expose only part of the process; their reliability depends on the quality and coverage of the curated knowledge graph.
paper_title: PathKGen: Pathology Knowledge Assisted MLLM for Explainable Histopathology
